name: Moderation
tagline: On-device content safety for an app: a keyword filter, an image-safety gate on your Core ML model, a moderator, and its SwiftUI.

illustrations.alt: A recipe feed with one photo blurred under its reason and one post hidden behind a Show button, the keyword list editor, and the ModerationKit package linked into the app.
illustrations.caption: On-device keyword and image checks, with SwiftUI to blur or hide posts.
